hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.local) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: *.local files are gitignored local secret/overrides. Edit them manually outside Claude."}}\n';; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // ""' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */install.sh|install.sh) command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; out=$(shellcheck "$f" 2>&1) && exit 0; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":%s}}\n' "$(printf %s "$out" | jq -Rs .)";; esac; }
